metadata.description: Plugins that make coding agents work with Diffinery, the git forge built for AI agents.

plugins.name: diffinery
plugins.description: Work with repositories hosted on Diffinery: pull requests, CI checks, workflow logs and issues through the diffinery CLI and the Diffinery MCP server.

plugins.name: diffinery-ci
plugins.description: Live CI for Diffinery pull requests: the branch's PR and its checks above the prompt and in the status line, a checks pane, and a note to Claude when CI on a commit it pushed settles (also in cloud sessions).
